retrievalProfile.description: A moody, cinematic portrait of a male musician with an acoustic guitar, featuring high-contrast side lighting and bold, wide-set metallic typography overlaid across the subject.
triggerTerms: moody studio lighting with lens flare

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a male artist holding an acoustic guitar, positioned in a dark, textured environment. The scene is defined by a strong back-left light source creating a dramatic lens flare and rim lighting. The typography is layered over the mid-section of the image, utilizing a mix of a script font and a heavy, wide, square-proportioned sans-serif with a gold-to-bronze gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: The guitar body acts as a dark canvas for the bright metallic text.
The lens flare in the upper left balances the heavy typography in the lower center.
The artist's gaze is directed slightly off-camera, creating an introspective mood.
The brick texture in the background provides a rugged, urban contrast to the polished studio lighting.
coreInvariants: Wide-aspect ratio for the primary display font
Metallic gradient texture on the main text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered-right, occupying approximately 60% of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The artist's face and the bright lens flare in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the lens flare, moves down the artist's face to the hands on the guitar, and finally rests on the bold horizontal text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows on the right side and dark background textures provide space for the subject to pop.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and cool blue (lens flare and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and bronze (typography and guitar trim)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low overall saturation with high value contrast between the light source and the shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and metallic finishes

letterConstructionRules: Softened or slightly rounded outer corners
Open counters in characters like 'C' and 'S'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' features a long, diagonal descender that underlines part of the preceding word.
The 'S' is flattened to match the horizontal stress of the other letters.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the guitar and artist's torso
tucked into the negative space above the main name

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a heavy, rigid geometric sans and a fluid, organic script.

preserve: Wide aspect ratio of the main font

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square, geometric structure of the main display text.
Provides the necessary horizontal expansion and technical feel.
Provides a casual, handwritten contrast for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a moody portrait of a male country singer with a beard, wearing a dark jacket, holding an acoustic guitar. Use high-contrast lighting with a strong white lens flare coming from the upper left. The background should be a dark, out-of-focus brick wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, ultra-wide geometric sans-serif name across the lower third in a gold metallic gradient. Above it, add a smaller script word in a dark teal gradient, slightly offset to the left.

verificationChecks: Is the main text wide and metallic?
Is there a prominent lens flare in the upper left?
Is the lighting high-contrast and moody?
Is the guitar visible in the lower half?

adjustableVariables: Specific instrument (e.g., electric vs acoustic guitar)
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subject
Specific decorative patterns on the guitar pickguard
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text doesn't obscure the artist's face.
Check that the metallic gradient looks reflective, not flat yellow.
Verify the lens flare doesn't wash out the entire image.
Confirm the script font is legible against the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Moody Portrait + Wide Metallic Sans-Serif + Script Accent + Lens Flare = Modern Country Aesthetic
